lessonTitle: Medical Affairs as a translator between science, clinical practice and strategy

slides.title: Medical Affairs' Irreplaceable Job Is Translation
bullets: Moves information across three languages: science, clinical practice, strategy
These languages rarely speak to each other directly
Losing accuracy in any one direction is where MSLs most often fail

slides.title: A Trial Result Is Not Yet a Clinical Answer
bullets: Translates hazard ratios and confidence intervals into a real consultation decision
Trial populations and endpoints don't map cleanly onto one patient
Reciting the headline result is not translation, just repetition

slides.title: Field Observations Aren't Insights Until Structured
bullets: Captures unmet needs, barriers, safety signals, guideline gaps from the field
Raw observations must be filtered, validated and tied to a decision
This exact step is the focus of Module 5

slides.title: Field Intelligence Shapes the Medical Plan
bullets: Connects field insight to the Medical Plan and evidence-generation agenda
Feeds publication planning and, where compliant, corporate strategy
This is the layer where Medical Affairs becomes a true strategic pillar

slides.title: Three Languages, One Professional
bullets: Scientific and statistical literacy to interpret evidence correctly
Field communication skills for real two-way dialogue
Business and strategic literacy to know what the organisation needs
Weakness in any one language creates a ceiling on impact

takeaway.title: Medical Affairs' core value is translating accurately between science, clinical practice and strategy
bullets: A trial result only matters once translated into a real clinical decision
Field observations become insights only when structured and validated
Weakness in any one of the three languages caps an MSL's impact
